newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: U.N. Assembly chief shocked by Jerusalem bombing.
newsitem.headline: U.N. Assembly chief shocked by Jerusalem bombing.

text.p: General Assembly President Razali Ismail of Malaysia expressed shock and horror on Thursday at the casualties caused by the bombing of a Jerusalem market Wednesday and urged peace and reconcilation.

"As president of the General Assembly, I must express shock and horror over the deaths and injuries as a result of the bombing in Jerusalem," he told the body at its first meeting since the attack by two Arab suicide bombers that killed 13 people.
"Our heart must go to the bereaved and we extend our condolences," he added.
"Our time is too often punctuated with violence and acts of extremism and destruction. We need to reach out for peace and reconciliation," Razali said.
Secretary-General Kofi Annan and members of the Security Council condemned the bombing in statements on Wednesday.
